items.title: Limitations of Kinetic Molecular Theory (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Limitations of Kinetic Molecular Theory: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Kinetic theory ke assumptions ideal gases par poore utarte hain. Real gases in se hat jati hain (deviation), kyun ke un ke molecules ke darmiyan forces hoti hain aur molecules ka apna volume bhi hota hai; yeh farq khaas taur par high pressure aur low temperature par nazar aata hai.

Mukhtasar yeh ke kinetic theory gas ke behaviour ki bari tasveer deti hai: pressure aur temperature jaisi naapi jane wali cheezon ko gas particles ki motion se jorti hai, aur thermodynamics aur statistical mechanics samajhne ki basis (jar) hai.
